[Nom] I picked up one of these a couple of weeks ago from the Outlet, same 32GB/1TB but it was Refurbished back to brand new condition, the battery only had a single cycle.
For the money it's an outstanding machine - but be aware that Lenovo don't offer any driver or BIOS updates or downloads for these models. You just get what ships on the machine, and that's it.
Make sure you download the tool to create a USB recovery key, and then create the key as soon as you receive the laptop, because that is the only way to reinstall Windows ARM with the correct drivers if you ever need to !! The drivers are not on the Lenovo site. https://support.lenovo.com/au/en/solutions/ht103653
[Nom] Also it came with Secure Boot disabled out of the box (??), you need to Enable it in the BIOS (use F2 to access BIOS or F12 for Boot Device Menu) and it's already got the new Secure Boot keys so it works properly immediately.
